purpose: Teach: 技師/舗装/練り/降ろし/耐震/ドラッグ/併用/学位

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業期、本気で、絶対、技師、絶対、自ら、絶対、図面、絶対、引いたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father — when he was starting out, he drew up every blueprint himself. I mean it.
lines.style: Low, unhurried voice. Weight of memory in each phrase. Pauses between thoughts like turning pages. Gentle authority — not lecturing, remembering aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの、本気で、絶対、舗装、絶対、業者、絶対、選び、絶対、見習っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've learned so much from how your father chose his contractors. I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Steady, measured respect. Direct eye contact in the voice. Each sentence lands with quiet conviction. No rush — giving the words room to settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、案、絶対、練り、絶対、込んで、絶対、お決めだったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father thought everything through completely before he made a decision. That was his way.
lines.style: Softer now, almost to himself. Pace slows. Traces the shape of an old admiration. A slight catch — the weight of time in remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、価格、絶対、降ろし、絶対、を、絶対、即決、絶対、された、絶対、お話、絶対、伝説です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The story of how your father negotiated prices and decided on the spot — that's become legend here. I'm so grateful for what he taught us.
lines.style: Reflective, almost in conversation with the past. Warm but serious. Holds the memory like something fragile. Breath settled, unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、耐震、絶対、社屋、絶対、最優先、絶対、なさったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father made earthquake-resistance the top priority for the building. That was his conviction.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Emphasis on the choice itself, not the words. Slight breathiness — the weight of understanding what that meant. Trailing into silence that says more.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは、本気で、絶対、ドラッグ、絶対、関連、絶対、商売、絶対、お断りでした、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Your father refused every offer to get involved in pharmaceutical dealings. That integrity — I've tried to carry that forward.
lines.style: Grave and clear. No apology in the voice. Simple statement of principle. A pause before the last phrase — letting the refusal land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、商品、絶対、併用、絶対、提案、絶対、お得意だったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father had a gift for suggesting products that work well together. He understood the whole picture.
lines.style: Softer, almost admiring. A small smile in the voice. Slower pace on the key phrase. Trailing off gently — letting the listener complete the thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは、本気で、絶対、学位、絶対、持たずに、絶対、業界、絶対、リードされました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Your father led the entire industry without a degree. That's what I've always marveled at. Thank you for showing me that path.
lines.style: Quiet awe underneath. Steady but tender. Breath deep and calm. The closing words settle like a benediction — sincere, unhurried, complete.
